name: 28-heal-before-misty
objective: Out of Route 4's grass and back across Cerulean to the nurse, whole, before the gym.
evidence: party_missing_hp=0 AND map=0x40 is the strongest claim the cartridge supports for a REPEAT heal at a Center it has already recorded. wLastBlackoutMap $D719 already reads 0x03 after link 26, so it cannot move again here and cannot prove anything - the same limit link 18 states after Brock's gym. Finishing inside the building is what forces anyone who is hurt through the nurse and stops the goal firing at a door.

party_missing_hp is the sum over the party of wPartyMonNMaxHP less wPartyMonNHP. A goal condition compares one number against a constant and 'current equals maximum' is not expressible that way, because the maximum moves with the party and with every level.

IT STARTS IN THE GRASS AND NOT IN A TOWN, because a training link's exit state is taken the instant the level ticks over - which is wherever the fight that earned it happened. The same shape link 16 has after link 15, and for the same reason.

A BLACKOUT IS A LEGAL DETOUR AND NOT A FAILURE: the cartridge heals the party on the way, so a run that blacks out satisfies party_missing_hp=0 the moment it wakes and only has to be standing in the building.
